description: ICL7660 charge pump (the original 7660; no boost pin, 10.5 V maximum supply)

source.licence: values read from the manufacturer's data sheet

note: A behavioural model, not the chip's circuit: the figures read from the maker's sheet (pump frequency, output resistance, voltage drop, supply current) drive Solum Builder's own model of a charge pump, switching ripple included (D-093).

rating_sources.vs_max: Renesas (Intersil) ICL7660/ICL7660A data sheet, FN3072 Rev 7.00 (Oct 2010): Absolute Maximum Ratings, Supply Voltage ICL7660 +10.5 V (the ICL7660A is rated 13 V)

package.name: 8-pin DIP
package.source: Renesas (Intersil) ICL7660/ICL7660A data sheet, FN3072 Rev 7.00 (Oct 2010), Pinouts, 8-lead PDIP/SOIC: NC 1, CAP+ 2, GND 3, CAP- 4, VOUT 5, LV 6, OSC 7, V+ 8. The pump's caps and diodes are drawn parts (D-226).

param_sources.f_pump: Renesas (Intersil) ICL7660/ICL7660A data sheet, FN3072 Rev 7.00 (Oct 2010): oscillator 10 kHz typ (Electrical Specifications, f_OSC); f_PUMP = f_OSC / 2 (page 8, Typical Applications)
param_sources.r_out: Renesas (Intersil) ICL7660/ICL7660A data sheet, FN3072 Rev 7.00 (Oct 2010): R_OUT 55 ohms typ at I_OUT = 20 mA, V+ = 5 V, 25 C (Electrical Specifications, ICL7660 column)
param_sources.i_q: Renesas (Intersil) ICL7660/ICL7660A data sheet, FN3072 Rev 7.00 (Oct 2010): supply current 170 uA typ, R_L = infinity, V+ = 5 V (Electrical Specifications, ICL7660 column)
param_sources.c_pump: Renesas (Intersil) ICL7660/ICL7660A data sheet, FN3072 Rev 7.00 (Oct 2010): C1 = 10 uF in the test circuit (Figure 11) the Electrical Specifications use

datasheet.source: Renesas (Intersil) ICL7660/ICL7660A data sheet, FN3072 Rev 7.00 (Oct 2010), Figure 7: output voltage vs load current at V+ = 5 V, slope 55 ohms
datasheet.note: Read off the figure (image): about -3.9 V at 20 mA, on the straight part of the curve (the sheet's 55-ohm slope).
